gui/501/ddev-autostart.site = {
	active count = 0
	path = /Users/me/Library/LaunchAgents/ddev-autostart.site.plist
	type = LaunchAgent
	state = not running

	program = /bin/sh
	arguments = {
		/bin/sh
		-c
		if mkdir -p "${4%/*}" 2>/dev/null && : >>"$4" 2>/dev/null; then exec >>"$4" 2>&1; fi; echo "== $(date): ddev start $3"; i=0; until "$1" info >/dev/null 2>&1; do i=$((i+1)); if [ "$i" -ge 150 ]; then echo "Docker did not respond within 5 minutes." >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 2; done; exec "$2" start "$3"
		ddev-autostart
		/opt/homebrew/bin/docker
		/opt/homebrew/bin/ddev
		site
		/Users/me/Library/Logs/ddev-autostart/site.log
	}

	working directory = /Users/me/Sites/site

	inherited environment = {
		DISPLAY => /var/run/com.apple.launchd.XXXXXXXXXX/org.xquartz:0
		SSH_AUTH_SOCK => /var/run/com.apple.launchd.XXXXXXXXXX/Listeners
	}

	default environment = {
		PATH => /usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
	}

	environment = {
		OSLogRateLimit => 64
		PATH => /opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
		HOME => /Users/me
		XPC_SERVICE_NAME => ddev-autostart.site
	}

	domain = gui/501 [100016]
	asid = 100016
	minimum runtime = 10
	exit timeout = 5
	runs = 1
	last terminating signal = Terminated: 15

	resource coalition = {
		ID = 177905
		type = resource
		state = active
		active count = 1
		name = ddev-autostart.site
	}

	jetsam coalition = {
		ID = 177906
		type = jetsam
		state = active
		active count = 1
		name = ddev-autostart.site
	}

	spawn type = daemon (3)
	jetsam priority = 40
	jetsam memory limit (active) = (unlimited)
	jetsam memory limit (inactive) = (unlimited)
	jetsamproperties category = daemon
	jetsam thread limit = 32
	cpumon = default

	properties = runatload | abandon process group | inferred program
}
